name: Explain toxic effects of psychoactive substances and poisons
description: Users sought detailed information regarding the toxicology, physiological effects, and risks associated with various psychoactive substances, alcohol, poisons, and environmental contaminants. This included specific inquiries about dosages for intoxication or lethality, mechanisms of harm, and the consequences of exposure to specific chemical or biological agents.
